name: Dilated human nuclear pore complex, integrative structural model

primary_citation.title: AI-based structure prediction empowers integrative structural analysis of human nuclear pores

assembly.description: C8-symmetric dilated NPC assembly; archive lists an 808-protein-chain assembly model.
assembly.coordinate_scope: Original asymmetric unit plus explicitly selected archive assembly operators

coverage.note: Counts describe deposited constructs; they do not establish full canonical-sequence coverage or nuclear abundance.

review.scope: Pinned archive identity, assembly presence, source checksum, coverage and summary metrics; no independent experimental re-refinement or local-map review.

nuclear_context.evidence_note: A structure entry establishes a model, not its quantity or position in the default cell.

limitations: Do not label all fitted atomic coordinates as directly measured: AI predictions and integrative fitting are integral to this model.
Intrinsically disordered FG regions and linker populations cannot be shown as one fully resolved rigid channel barrier.
This is a dilated state; pore geometry responds to biological context and membrane tension.
Import assembly transforms explicitly and reuse sectors/subunits; the whole pore is far beyond the current single-nucleosome atom budget.
The displayed pore-marker count in BioSim remains a sampling choice, independent of the subunit stoichiometry of one NPC.
The related 7TBJ title refers to a 12 Å map while its RCSB resolution field currently reports 23 Å; avoid copying a resolution solely from an entry title.

research_reference.name: Dilated human nuclear pore complex, integrative structural model

organism.expression_system: In-cell structural context plus component models

research_reference.method: Integrative modeling combining cryo-electron tomography/subtomogram averaging, component structures and AI-based prediction
research_reference.resolution_scope: Resolution of the associated in-cell cryo-ET map, not atom-level accuracy of every fitted component

assembly.description: C8-symmetric dilated NPC assembly; archive lists an 808-protein-chain assembly model.
assembly.structural_scope: Large integrative scaffold model, not a completely experimentally resolved atomic pore

coverage.scope_note: RCSB entry-level summary; inspect assembly operators before expanding geometry. Generated biological-assembly counts can differ. None of these numbers is a whole-nucleus pore count.

suggested_representations: reusable scaffold-sector/subunit meshes with assembly transforms
source-specific atomic subunits only when their individual provenance supports them
